purpose: General parity matrix for the /test2 MapLibre route against the production main route.

rules.meaning: The visible shell, state, text, pane structure, or data contract should match main. A difference is a bug unless explicitly reclassified.
The user-facing behaviour should match main, but the implementation is allowed to differ because /test2 uses MapLibre/vector tiles instead of Leaflet/FGB.
The difference is expected and should not be hidden: MapLibre canvas/control internals, attribution text, tile loading mechanics, and vector-tile hit-testing internals can differ.
The parity target cannot be fully exercised until matching source geometry, tile packages, search indexes, or election/geography mappings exist.

areas.title: Desktop application shell
expectations: Top navbar branding, links, support button, theme button, header height, and main split-pane structure match main.
Search input placement and catalogue pane width match main within a tight tolerance.

areas.title: Default catalogue browsing
expectations: The catalogue uses the production flat catalogue containers and row classes.
The top-level browsing workflow remains catalogue-first.
By-decade election entries remain cards/sections rather than individual election rows in the table of contents.

areas.title: Map controls
expectations: Visible zoom, compass, settings/accessibility, active-layer controls, timeline, and mobile catalogue controls do not collide.
The controls look and behave like main where practical, even though their backing implementation is MapLibre.

areas.title: Ordinary converted map layers
expectations: Representative converted non-election layers load from the main catalogue callback.
Ordinary polygon fills default transparent unless the main catalogue explicitly styles them otherwise.
Labels, hover, click, and feature details work through MapLibre feature queries.

areas.title: Feature details cards
expectations: Feature labels and selected feature info use repaired source properties and avoid generic 'Unnamed Feature' output where the main data has a usable label.
Feature details appear in the same top-right map pane location and catalogue/detail workflow as main.

areas.title: Election overall result pane
expectations: The Dail 2024 overall party table rows, headers, tab state, and pane title match main for the representative URL.
The visible election pane is rendered through the shared main-pane contract.

areas.title: Election selected constituency/DEA panes
expectations: Selected constituency party/candidate/count pane DOM matches main for named screenshot cases.
Main row-admissibility, status semantics, sort/filter controls, and selected-pane percent formatting are preserved.

areas.title: Election map overlays
expectations: Election fills, strokes, labels, timeline, and seat-circle DOM overlays visually mirror main where possible.
MapLibre-specific drawing remains confined to polygon styling, feature hit-testing, and anchor positioning.

areas.title: Timeline slider
expectations: Timeline dates render as DD MMM YYYY.
Layer/election switching keeps the same user-facing timeline controls as main.

areas.title: Browse routes
expectations: Browse navbar route works from the shared shell.
Map Browse pages show prominent general-interest information, thumbnail, sources/downloads where available, and hide raw technical fields behind collapsed technical details.

areas.title: URL/share restore
expectations: Layer IDs, election IDs, viewport, hidden layers, detail/source panels, selected election substate, and mobile/sidebar state restore without leaving /test2.

areas.title: Mobile shell and controls
expectations: The catalogue/menu toggle belongs in the navbar on mobile.
Touch targets are usable and controls do not overlap zoom, scale, timeline, or catalogue history controls.

areas.title: Full catalogue data coverage
expectations: Every main catalogue entry needs converted/loadable MapLibre-compatible geometry or an explicit not-yet-converted state.
Remaining invalid or absent source geometries must be fixed before exact map-layer parity is possible.

areas.title: Rendering-engine internals
expectations: Leaflet DOM/SVG internals and MapLibre canvas/source internals are not expected to match.
Only the visible behaviour and public UI contract are parity targets.
